compiler_spec: none: address-space fixture, no Architecture/ProtoModel/symbols involved

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the locked Address/Range/RangeList surface over a minimal Translate subclass (C++) / SpaceRegistry (Rust) built with the production derived space constructors
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh manager with the same eleven spaces inserted in index order via insertSpace; addresses constructed through the public constructors only (m_minimal/m_maximal sentinels included)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: boolean/integer/hex observations of isInvalid, printRaw, operator==/!=/</<=, getAddrSize, wrap arithmetic, justifiedContain/containedBy/overlap/overlapJoin/isContiguous, RangeList ordering and query results, and exact LowlevelError strings for property errors
analysis_options.normalization: No normalization: identical observation strings printed by both sides; the C++ invalid address always uses the m_minimal constructor so the indeterminate default-ctor offset is never observed

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: invalid_vs_ram0: default/m_minimal constructors vs a real ram:0 address; isInvalid, printRaw (invalid_addr vs padded hex), ==/!=/<>/< = and the m_maximal sentinel ordering, isConstant/isJoin, shortcut chars

cross_space_ordering: 14 addresses across const/OTHER/unique/ram/register/stack/join/iop plus the minimal and maximal sentinels inserted scrambled into a sorted container; walk prints index-then-offset order and explicit cross-space operator< results

wrap_boundaries: operator+/- through AddrSpace::wrapOffset on a 4-byte space (0xffffffff boundary), a 4-byte wordsize-2 space (0x1ffffffff boundary), and 8-byte ram; overlap with positive/negative skip, constant-space and cross-space -1 paths

justified_big_endian: justifiedContain on BE vs LE vs forceleft containers (off1-off2 vs op2.offset-offset), containment failures, containedBy, isContiguous direction per endianness, and the overlapJoin dispatch incl. ConstantSpace -1

range_space_isolation: insertRange keeps adjacent same-space ranges separate and never merges across spaces; inRange size boundary (1ffc/1ffd), getRange in/out of space, Range::contains space identity, overlap merge, removeRange split

rangelist_queries: longestFit chaining and maxsize/space/invalid stops, getFirstRange/getLastRange, getLastSignedRange positive and negative-only views, getLastAddrOpen including the final-space ~0-sentinel-base quirk, and merge of a second list
range_properties: Range construction from RangeProperties — explicit bounds, missing last defaulting to getHighest, Undefined space and Illegal range tag errors, and the flash4 4-byte highest bound
